user_problem: A supplied text needs questions that progress from locating information to interpreting and evaluating it.
unique_output: A question ladder with text location, cognitive move, expected evidence, and answerability check.
required_input: Complete short passage, learning goal, permitted question levels, and expected response length.
critical_rule: Every question must be answerable from the passage unless explicitly labeled as reflection requiring no factual claim.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is source-note-to-outline; this creates evidence-grounded reading prompts rather than organizing notes into content.
acceptance_scenario: Input passage says a town moved market day after floods reduced attendance; goal is causal-language analysis. Output asks what changed, what reason is stated, and whether the passage proves floods were the sole cause; expected answer says no.
